title: SpaceX agrees to testify to NYC Council about AI safety after receiving subpoena
script:
SpaceX has agreed to testify before the New York City Council regarding AI safety.
The company reached this deal after receiving a formal subpoena from the city government.
This hearing focuses on how AI tools are being implemented and their safety implications.
Council members are examining the potential risks of these automated systems within the five boroughs.
The council previously requested information from several technology firms to understand their specific AI software.
SpaceX executives are now scheduled to appear to provide testimony on these specific technical protocols.
Should private companies be forced to disclose their AI safety data to local officials?
